text: MCP clients can hand off complex, multi-step work to Computer and get structured results back
quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.

text: Any MCP client that supports HTTP transport can connect to the Computer MCP server using its URL, including a one-line setup for Claude Code
quote: Any MCP client that supports the HTTP transport can connect using the server URL

text: The MCP server authenticates users with OAuth 2.0 through their Perplexity account, so no API key is needed
quote: The Computer MCP Server authenticates users via OAuth 2.0 using your Perplexity account. No API key is required.

text: Reusing a thread_id on later calls continues the same session
quote: Reuse that `thread_id` on later calls to continue the same session.

text: Tasks can keep running after a call returns, and clients can check back later using the same thread_id
quote: The task may still be running. Keep the `thread_id` and call `call_perplexity_computer` again with that same `thread_id`

text: Status updates are sent as MCP progress notifications while a task runs
quote: The Computer MCP server sends status updates as MCP progress notifications while a task runs.

text: Files upload directly without passing through the MCP server, with a 200 MB maximum file size
quote: The MCP server never sees the file contents, so uploads scale to large binaries without going through the worker. The maximum file size is 200 MB

text: Clients can approve or deny sensitive actions, such as sending an email or deploying code
quote: Approves or denies a sensitive action like sending an email or deploying code.

text: Clients can relay answers back when Computer asks for more information mid-task
quote: Relays answers when Computer asks for more information.

text: Computer can search and browse the web for real-time information, including pages that require login
quote: Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages

text: Computer can run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel and collect the results into structured output
quote: Run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel, collecting results into structured output.

text: Computer can take high-fidelity screenshots of any webpage
quote: Take high-fidelity screenshots of any webpage.

text: Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with a persistent workspace and preinstalled Python, Node.js, ffmpeg, and Unix tools
quote: Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with a persistent file workspace. Python, Node.js, ffmpeg, and standard Unix tools are pre-installed

text: Computer can process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, image, audio, and video files
quote: Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files.

text: Computer can create PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos
quote: Create documents and media including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos

text: Computer can build websites and deploy them to a live public URL in minutes
quote: Build and deploy websites to a live public URL in minutes

text: Computer can read and send email through Gmail and Outlook and schedule calendar events
quote: Read and send emails via Gmail and Outlook, and schedule calendar events

text: Computer can connect to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth
quote: Connect to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth

text: Computer can manage tasks across GitHub, Linear, Jira, Asana, Slack, Notion, and other tools
quote: Manage tasks across GitHub, Linear, Jira, Asana, Slack, Notion, and more

text: Computer can analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce, and other sources
quote: Analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce, and other sources

text: When a task needs a new service connection, Computer returns an auth_required event and resumes on the same thread after authentication
quote: If Computer needs to connect to a service mid-task, it returns an `auth_required` event, and after authentication the conversation resumes on the same thread

text: An Analytics API provides Computer usage as time series in UTC-aligned buckets for BI tools or internal reporting
quote: as bucketed time series you can pull into BI tools or internal reporting.

text: Organizations can turn on the Analytics API to provision API access
quote: Turn on Analytics API to provision API access for your organization.

text: Analytics API requests are free and do not use API credits
quote: Analytics requests are free and don't consume API credits.

text: Usage analytics can be broken down per organization member or filtered to one member by email
quote: `GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage` breaks a dataset down **per member** instead of as a single org total.
